<b>{{PAGENAME}}</b> is a consumable product, able to restore a relatively small amount of health and a moderate amount of energy. It can be brewed at varying quality levels using a [[brewing stand]]. The quality of the crafts depend on the quality of the [[hops]] used. It is the least profitable drink that can be sold at Talking skull.

==Quest==
The crafting recipe can be obtained from [[Horadric]] after opening the buffet on [[Witch Hill]]. Rumors of the high quality beer served at witch burnings make [[Horadric]] curious, asking the player for {{Item|A mug of beer|1|gold}}. After bringing him the beer [[Horadric]] will reward the player with the recipe for a mug of mead.

==Trading==
With the DLC ''[[Stranger sins|Stranger Sins]]'', mugs of mead - as with most beverages - may be sold regularly, either passively by being stored in the [[Talking Skull]]s cellar, or actively by being stored in the [[Barman]]s inventory and triggering an event.
